title: Testing lossless checkpoint recovery
change: Prepared32 versus64 simulations with fixed eight roots and frozen weights.
result: Validate storage-safe immutable checkpoint recovery/archive capacity and interrupted-resume equivalence before further paid long training. No new allocation until these prerequisites and a frozen costed plan are ready.

revision.summary: Proposed standalone lossless checkpoint compression diagnostic
revision.reason: Two recovered full states exceed2GB; duplicate recovery and archive copies limit safe longer training.
changes: diagnostics/retention/compressed_checkpoint.py: bounded streaming gzip and restored-content verification
diagnostics/retention/test_compressed_checkpoint.py: exact roundtrip, corruption and immutable destination checks
revision.test_plan: Run small corruption and roundtrip tests, then measure a real recovered state; this does not test playing strength or GPU resume equivalence.

decision.reviewing: Does the reference Q rule affect actual frozen arena decisions?
options: Prepare a single-change candidate after source-bound tests
evidence: On32 frozen development histories,31 visit policies and8 argmax actions changed; mean total variation0.1201.
Mean visited root actions increased from8.0 to9.21875; scalar/batched/static parity fixtures passed.
decision.reason: The discrepancy affects decisions, but no new game or strength benefit is measured.
decision.next_action: Publish diagnostic evidence and prepare one isolated Q-completion change with unchanged loss.
